changelog.release_notes: Quality release: better shape key fitting on clothing, cleaner texture bakes, and a simpler panel.
new_features: Simple / Full panel modes with separate settings
Smoothing masks for shape keys: boundary, centre seam and inward, with auto-apply
Automatic clipping correction after a shape key transfer
Rigid Fit +: small islands (buttons, zippers) follow the garment and keep their shape
Use Target as Source: copy between two regions of the same mesh
Backups: restore the target mesh from any past transfer
Report a Bug: send logs anonymously (view before sending)
Live progress window with learned time estimates
Preserve X Symmetry for shape key and vertex group transfers
changes: Shape transfer onto a mesh WITH shape keys now re-anchors the Basis, so the change is visible
Texture: bake margin applies to the projection engine, and defaults to 8 px
Texture: Max Ray Distance defaults to 0.01 and Cage Extrusion to 0.001, with plainer explanations
Transfer button turns red when a run will take over 2 minutes, or when Vertex ID meets different vertex counts
Search Method advanced options removed - the tolerances adapt on their own now
Panel: option buttons respond instantly (no undo snapshot per click)
Much better transfer time estimates, including texture bakes
Vertex order transfer is 5x faster on heavy meshes
Addon size reduced from 421 MB to 153 MB
fixes: Vertex Group + Preserve X Symmetry wiped weights when the source origin was off-centre
Active UV ignored the mesh positions, so World and Local space gave different results
Texture bakes left dark dots along UV seams
Texture: Local space was ignored by the projection engine
Vertex Index + Raycast did nothing at all
Full UI option buttons could stop responding after visiting the Simple UI
Shape key transfers left every key value at 1
Surface Deform with Pre-Subdivide took minutes instead of seconds
Vertex ID with different vertex counts now warns instead of failing silently
